[[File:Wizards_Tower.png|thumb|right|250px|The Wizard's Tower]]
{{Quote|The Chancellor's signal is coming from right there. The observation platform at the top of that spire.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|audio=ChancellorsSignal-ROTS.flac|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Wizard's Tower''' was the name given to the conning tower and accompanying sensor and communications pod of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. The pod also contained the room known as the [[General's quarters]], which was outfitted by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] shortly before the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

The Wizard's Tower was refitted as a sanctum for the Count of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] during the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and it was from here that Dooku continued to broadcast [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] propaganda over [[Shadowfeed/Legends|Shadowfeed]] and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channels to further subvert the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] war effort. The tower was protected by point-defense [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] located midway down the shaft, which also contained [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] providing access to the observation deck. An interstellar communications array was located atop the pod.

Dooku held [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] captive on the observation deck of the Wizard's Tower during [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] strike at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. It also hosted a duel between Dooku and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], which resulted in Dooku's execution at Skywalker's hand. The Count's body remained there when the ''Invisible Hand'', damaged during the battle, split in two. The aft section was thought to have burned up in Coruscant's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], taking the Wizard's Tower with it.
